name: lucid-dream
description: One memory shared by all your AI agents. Loads the memory index when a session starts, logs each session, and wakes an idle session when another agent messages it. Talks only to the lucid-dream server you run. Needs the lucid-dream program installed.

url.title: Server address
url.description: Your lucid-dream server's MCP address, for example http://my-pc:7878/mcp.

token.title: Token
token.description: This device's token, from `lucid-dream token add claude` on the machine that holds the memory.
